name: Stormbringer: Thunderous and Hydro Powered raise spell critical damage natively (#1212, #1686)
contract: #1212: Thunderous (804827) is a single SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (163) effect, EffectBasePoints 149 + DieSides 1 = +150, EffectMiscValue 126 (all magic schools). #1686: Hydro Powered (300616) is the same aura, EffectBasePoints 34 + DieSides 1 = +35, same misc 126. Both are unconditional (no class mask), so both apply to any non-physical spell the caster casts. Aura 163 has a no-op handler; the actual math is Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus (Unit.cpp:9924-9955): for a magic-class spell (Shock 804020, DmgClass 1, SchoolMask 8 Nature, inside the 126 mask) the pre-mod crit bonus on a 1000 base is damage/2 = 500 (total crit hit 1500, the standard 150% for a magic spell), then crit_mod = GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscMask(MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, schoolMask) is applied via AddPct(crit_bonus, crit_mod) before crit_bonus -= damage. With Thunderous's +150: 1500 * 2.5 = 3750, minus the 1000 base = 2750 bonus, i.e. +2250 over the unmodified 500 bonus (total crit hit 3750 vs 1500). With Hydro Powered's +35: 1500 * 1.35 = 2025, minus 1000 = 1025 bonus, i.e. +525 over the unmodified 500 (total crit hit 2025 vs 1500). spell_critical_damage calculates exactly this function on a fixed base of 1000; the assertion is a delta against a snapshot taken before learning each passive, following the same shape PR #4669's Pyromancer precedent (pyromancer-pyromancy-crit-damage.json) used for the identical aura on a different class. Neither passive has any module code; both close as regression scenarios only.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: Shock critical hit on a 1000 base before either passive
DISCRIMINATING: Thunderous adds 2250 to Shock's critical hit (150% crit-damage bonus)
Unlearning Thunderous restores the baseline critical hit
DISCRIMINATING: Hydro Powered adds 525 to Shock's critical hit (35% crit-damage bonus)
